custom.waiting: Waiting for you to scan with WeChat…
custom.verifyDescription: Enter the number shown in WeChat to continue.
custom.verifyMismatch: That code did not match. Enter the new number shown in WeChat.
custom.expired: WeChat login expired. Scan again to reconnect.
custom.failed: Unable to connect WeChat. Try again.
custom.deleteInstanceWarning: This removes the local account and instance and revokes its project assignment, provisioning and active pairing codes. Conversation history is kept.
custom.rescanWarning: Scan a new QR code for this same instance. The current saved credentials remain unchanged if you cancel or the login fails; they are replaced only after successful login.
custom.rePairTitle: Unlink and pair this instance again?
custom.rePairWarning: This unlinks the current project assignment and invalidates old pairing codes. The account stays logged in, but normal delivery is suspended until the new pairing code is verified and consumed.
